title: Candy Johnson
summary: Fields hired Candy Johnson in Ohio for a tour before he joined Basie.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now, Candy Johnson, he used to mention you; I knew him well. He was a great tenor player who worked with Basie. How long did Candy work with you?

Not too long. Candy didn't work--I picked him up in Ohio, I forget what town it was, and I would say maybe a season or a tour, like we'd make these tours, and then a little later after that I heard he was with Basie; I don't know how long he stayed with Basie.
Not long. 1951 I think it was.
Since then Candy has visited me and he's married and doing fine. I think he's teaching.
I hope we have enough tape so we won't have to interrupt, one of the most interesting stories is the story of how "In The Mood" happened.
